protocol.fairness: Geographic completion-rate disparity only; no demographic or protected-class data.
protocol.robust_policy: One-step auction with district service deficit, trip length and known selected-edge disruption penalty; idle repositioning uses learned zone arrival rates. Not robust MPC or reinforcement learning.
protocol.event_knowledge: All policies know current closures. Robust additionally knows which edge may close; this is an information advantage, not an isolated algorithm comparison.
protocol.search_eval_horizon: Search uses 80 min; test uses 100 min. Stress is a discovered toy failure case, not a worst-case guarantee.

limitations: All networks and demand are synthetic; no real emergency or equity outcomes validated.
Four test seeds provide weak tail-risk estimates; CVaR25 here is the worst single run.
Unfinished trips at the horizon count as active, not completed; compare within same horizon.
Auction is heuristic, not globally optimal; rates are simple count estimates.
No demographic fairness, causal validity or operational disaster-response claim.
